## Decision

Describe the decision or idea briefly.

See the [Documentation Lifecycle Guide](../../docs/lifecycle.md) and select the current stage below.

## Context

Why was this decision made? What problem does it solve?

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches were evaluated?

## Consequences

What are the expected outcomes or implications?

## Checklist

- [ ] The decision and problem are clearly described
- [ ] Relevant context and alternatives are documented
- [ ] Expected consequences are identified
- [ ] The current lifecycle stage is selected below
- [ ] Related documentation or issues are linked

## Status

- [ ] Proposed
- [ ] Under Review
- [ ] Approved
- [ ] Ready for Graduation
- [ ] Graduated
- [ ] Paused / Archived / Rejected
